inclusions.source: The visit includes the interior of Khufu's pyramid: a steep, low passage descending into the granite core, airless and close, that resolves something photographs do not.
In the evening you board the overnight sleeper train to Aswan.
Dinner aboard; by morning you are deep in Upper Egypt.

inclusions.text: Private felucca chartered for your party alone
inclusions.source: This is a private departure — the felucca chartered for your party alone.

inclusions.text: Egyptologist at the cultural sites; felucca captain and crew
inclusions.source: Your Egyptologist handles the cultural sites; the felucca captain and crew handle the boat, the cooking, and the river itself, with their own knowledge of where the wind drops at three in the afternoon and which island is sheltered when the khamaseen blows.
The evening ends with a Nubian barbecue under open sky.
The day closes with the overnight train back to Cairo.
The correct final note before the airport transfer.
